skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/h.change: Local fix pending upstream: legacy-format entry starts are recognized only before the first modern entry, so archived bodies with legacy-looking lines stay archivable. History byte offsets are computed in one incremental pass.

Local fix pending upstream: clear and seal parse archive sources under their queried archive/<batch>.md name. clear checks for pending completed work like seal and defers with pending-archive. A malformed or unreadable work file blocks clear and seal with pending-unknown when it may be completed: unreadable, no title on the first line, or not exactly one 狀態 line reading 進行中 or 受阻; other malformed works are re-checked before writing and reported in warnings. After the selected-identity check, a work without format problems also blocks clear and seal with pending-unknown when its whole text has more than one status line or a merge-conflict marker line (<<<<<<<, >>>>>>> or ||||||| at the line start followed by a space or the line end).

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/a.change: Local fix pending upstream: completed work is checked for exact archivability (check_archivable) and reported as format with a reword/replacement hint; title line compared after stripping; CRLF histories get CRLF marker and separator, and a CRLF separator before a following entry is accepted on retry. archive accepts an optional tracking (default or track) and applies it after a successful archival, returning partial tracking-failed with archived true when tracking fails; the archival run by a completed save does not apply it again. An empty or whitespace-only history is framed like a new one.

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/w.change: Local fix pending upstream: create/update refuse a 完成 save whose body would not archive; a completed work accepts one reviewed replacement keeping title, 更新 and 狀態：完成 when history lacks that identity; update details follow the file newline. A details update that would hide or change the level-1/2 sections after the managed details is refused with details-format; create/update results add warnings for level-1/2 headings inside details and update results add preserved_sections. An archival failure after a completed save returns partial archive-failed with cause_code and recovery retry-archive. The details-update sibling check compares headings together with their offsets inside the verbatim tail. A completed save whose tracking failed recommends archive with the same tracking choice. A details update is refused with details-format when the old details hide level-1/2 headings in a fence left open at the end or in a fence holding a same-character opener with an info string. Blank optional fields are input errors; create normalizes CRLF and CR in details to LF.

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/c.change: Local fix pending upstream: invalid JSON, non-UTF-8 or too deeply nested stdin is an input error, and any unexpected exception becomes a JSON internal error with exit 2. Usage errors use the JSON envelope with code usage and a missing selected file is not-found (exit 2); --help stays plain text. A FileNotFoundError is not-found only for a file inside the selected project (or, without a file name, for read/archive/compare of a named work); otherwise io. A duplicate JSON key on stdin is an input error.

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/s.change: Local fix pending upstream: superscript COM and LPT names are reserved. read_file change detection ignores st_ctime (stat and fstat disagree on Windows with Python 3.12+). A linked --project path or ancestor above the project is resolved once with a strict realpath and registered as the trusted root; check_path stops at that root after confirming it still resolves to itself. The Git root is the resolved path or its nearest ancestor that is the Git top level; a path crossing a link below the repository root is uncertain. Volumes without strict realpath keep the previous full-ancestor link checks. create_file removes the partial file it created when writing fails (same st_dev/st_ino) and re-raises the original error. git_environment also removes Git's remaining local repository variables (GIT_IMPLICIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_PREFIX, GIT_GRAFT_FILE, GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS, GIT_REPLACE_REF_BASE, GIT_SHALLOW_FILE, GIT_CONFIG) and GIT_REDIRECT_STDIN/STDOUT/STDERR while keeping user configuration variables; a successful root discovery with empty or non-absolute output is uncertain instead of the current directory. work_path and work_paths share one work-name rule (.md suffix after a nonempty stem, not history.md). replace_file makes its temporary file writable before removing it, suppresses cleanup errors and reports a failed replacement of a target without the write bit as read-only. Only symbolic links and name-surrogate reparse points count as links; a zero lstat tag with the reparse attribute is taken from the parent directory listing, and a missing entry or zero tag stays refused.

skills/handoff/scripts/feather_handoff/o.change: Local fix pending upstream: source change detection ignores st_ctime (stat and fstat disagree on Windows with Python 3.12+). Duplicate-source detection uses the resolved path when st_ino is unavailable.
